class: Learning done only at the end, from what the last page shows
symptom: An answer the owner gave on a middle page while the run waited for them (then pressed Continue) was used for that run only; the same question came back on the next form.
root_cause: note_owner_changes() kept the owner's answers in the run's memory so they would not be overwritten; they were learned only by learn_user_answers() at the hand-over, which reads the page on screen then -- the Review page -- where a question from step 3 is not.
why_tests_missed: The learning tests read one page at hand-over; none answered on an earlier page during a pause.
fix: note_owner_changes() keeps each changed answer at once (_keep_owner_answer): against this application for this employer, and in the saved answers when profile_setup.worth_keeping() says so; legal, visa and signed answers are not kept. waiting_questions() drops a question answered and saved under its own words.
prevention: Record what the user teaches at the moment they teach it, not at a later point that may not see it.
